title: Identification of diagnostic biomarks and immune cell infiltration in ulcerative colitis.
authors: Chen, Qin; Bei, Shaosheng; Zhang, Zhiyun; Wang, Xiaofeng; Zhu, Yunying
one_liner_zh: 该文利用转录组数据筛选溃疡性结肠炎诊断标志物并分析免疫浸润，虽涉及KLF9等转录因子但未聚焦蛋白-DNA互作或结合机制，且无AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: We aimed to explore diagnostic biomarks and immune cell infiltration characteristics in ulcerative colitis (UC). We used the dataset GSE38713 as the training set and dataset GSE94648 as the test set. A total of 402 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were obtained from GSE38713. Annotating, visualizing, and integrating discovery of these differential genes was performed using Gene Ontology (GO), Kyoto Gene and Genome Encyclopedia Pathway (KEGG), and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA). Protein-protein interaction networks were constructed from the STRING database, and protein functional modules were identified using the CytoHubba plugin of Cytoscape. Random forest and LASSO regression were used to screen for UC-related diagnostic markers, and ROC curves were generated to validate their diagnostic value. The composition of 22 immune cells was analyzed, and the immune cell infiltration in UC was analyzed using CIBERSORT. Results: Seven diagnostic markers associated with UC were identified: TLCD3A, KLF9, EFNA1, NAAA,WDR4, CKAP4, and CHRNA1. Immune cell infiltration assessment revealed that macrophages M1, activated dendritic cells, and neutrophil cells infiltrated relatively more compared to normal control samples. Our results suggest a new functional feature of UC and suggest potential biomarkers for UC through comprehensive analysis of integrated gene expression data.
abstract_zh: 我们旨在探索溃疡性结肠炎（UC）中的诊断生物标志物及免疫细胞浸润特征。我们使用数据集GSE38713作为训练集，数据集GSE94648作为测试集。从GSE38713中获得了总共402个差异表达基因（DEGs）。利用基因本体论（GO）、京都基因与基因组百科全书通路（KEGG）和基因集富集分析（GSEA）对这些差异基因进行注释、可视化和整合发现。基于STRING数据库构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络，并使用Cytoscape的CytoHubba插件识别蛋白质功能模块。采用随机森林和LASSO回归筛选UC相关诊断标志物，并生成ROC曲线以验证其诊断价值。分析了22种免疫细胞的组成，并使用CIBERSORT分析UC中的免疫细胞浸润。结果：鉴定出七个与UC相关的诊断标志物：TLCD3A、KLF9、EFNA1、NAAA、WDR4、CKAP4和CHRNA1。免疫细胞浸润评估显示，与正常对照样本相比，巨噬细胞M1、活化树突状细胞和中性粒细胞浸润相对较多。我们的结果揭示了UC的新功能特征，并通过整合基因表达数据的综合分析，为UC提供了潜在的生物标志物。
